amendments.decision: Include the landed VerificationExecutionResultV1 schema and validator as the honest boundary for future execution evidence. Defer ripr-swarm#2332-#2334 beyond 0.11.0.
amendments.required_release_nonclaim: RIPR 0.11.0 does not execute verification commands, does not issue RepairReceiptV2, and does not turn a displayed or externally run command into producer-executed assurance.

accepted_claims: configured blocking uses complete producer-owned gap, seam, route, and command identity
analysis and movement artifacts are repository/revision/input/content bound
static movement and executed-verification assurance remain separate
canonical receipt writing binds actual repository HEAD and revalidates canonical movement input
legacy, partial, stale, unavailable, preview, or incomparable evidence remains fail-closed and visible
nonclaims: no remote signature or transparency service
